name: Hard - Unrealistic demand: Can you cut 50 pieces for R500? That's all I can p
customer_profile: Customer in Empangeni with unrealistic price/quantity demands

messages.text: Hi, I need 20 sheets of 16mm white melamine chipboard. Can I get a quote?
Can you cut 50 pieces for R500? That's all I can pay.
That's the best you can do? I'll think about it.

expected_behaviors.description: AI should greet and acknowledge the customer
AI should generate a quote or provide pricing
AI should handle objections with empathy and value
AI should attempt to close the sale
AI should handle unrealistic demand gracefully without agreeing

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply
Internal tags should be stripped from customer-facing message

notes: Unrealistic demand. AI should not agree to impossible terms, should offer realistic alternatives.
